title: Apostle beats JSON contract
description: Single source of truth for what buildFromBeats builds. See sample-beats.json for a working example. Transits eat into the following beat's duration; they never extend total runtime. Any text-bearing beat must rest at least 1.8s after its transit completes — the builder extends the beat and logs a warning when violated.

schemaVersion.description: 2 = brief-pipeline schema: stable beatIds, sections, per-beat motion block, brand kit provenance. All v2 fields are optional additions; v1 files remain valid.

briefId.description: v2: stable identifier for the client brief this build came from (e.g. acme-launch-video1)

scriptVersion.description: v2: increments each time the client revises the script; diffBeats compares consecutive versions

sourceScriptPath.description: v2: repo-relative path of the raw script this was parsed from

wpm.description: Words per minute for VO-paced timing. Spoken word count with URLs and prices expanded.

masterName.description: Base name for the build. Every build is versioned: the actual master comp is <masterName>_vNNN (auto-incremented, never overwrites), filed under project folder APOSTLE/<masterName>_vNNN/{01_MASTER, 02_SCENES, 03_ASSETS}. Scene precomps are prefixed with the versioned name.

rig.description: Camera rig. expression = autonomous two-node rig, zero manual steps (the default and the Phase 3 A/B winner). handycam = HandyCam effect rig — requires one human Setup click and CANNOT do station transport (Position Offset is shake-scale; the Setup-baked look-at stays pinned); explicit opt-in for static-position polish only. auto = resolves to expression.

sections.description: v2: the script's chapters (numbered headers like '1. Earning...'). Beats reference sections via sectionId. Sections drive pacing review and the panel's timing bars; section-title cards are ordinary beats whose beatId ends in '-title'.

id.description: kebab-case slug, stable across script revisions

kitId.description: v2: brand kit this block was resolved from (brands/<kitId>.json). The parser resolves the kit into the concrete fields below before the file reaches AE — ExtendScript never loads kits.

fontHeadingPS.description: PostScript name. Seeds the master comp's FONT Heading guide layer — after build, retype that layer's text to change every heading font in the build.

fontBodyPS.description: PostScript name. Seeds the FONT Body guide layer (same master-control mechanism).

headingTracking.description: Seeds the Heading Tracking slider on CONTROL (uniform letter-spacing, AE tracking units)

bodyTracking.description: Seeds the Body Tracking slider on CONTROL

logo.description: Path to logo footage, or null

beatId.description: v2: stable kebab-case identity, assigned once at first parse and inherited across script revisions (diffBeats matches on it). Written to the scene precomp's comment field at build time so surgical edit ops can find the beat's layers. Never regenerated.

sectionId.description: v2: id of the section this beat belongs to

contentHash.description: v2: hash of normalized superText+vo; identical beats across sibling videos share it (reuse candidates report)

motion.description: v2: per-beat motion personality. Build stores these; the Phase 6 motion system consumes ease/entrance/exit; handycam sets the polish-layer intensity (default per brand kit; 'subtle' for client work per 2026-07-28 decision).

ease.description: ease profile or explicit easing name (e.g. corporate-smooth, outQuint, outBack)

entrance.description: text entrance preset (fadeRise, staggerRise, trackIn, maskReveal, listCascade)

exit.description: text exit preset; default mirrors entrance

handycam.description: HandyCam polish intensity for this beat

voSpokenWords.description: Spoken word count (URLs and prices expanded). Preferred over counting vo words.

visual.description: Intent note for the visual; not built literally

uiStates.description: uiWalkthrough only: number of UI states; adds 1.2s dwell per state

durationSec.description: null = compute from VO at meta.wpm. A number is fixed; never overridden.

endcard.description: Folded into beats as a final endcard beat at build time
